IP Tools; kaydettiğiniz IP aralığını tar: IP Tools scans the IP range you have saved and lists the devices on your network with their names, MAC vendors and open services. Click a service tag to open the web interface, remote desktop or shared folder. Local network only, discovery only.

Önce canlılık (işletim sisteminin kendi: First liveness (the operating system's own ping tool and the ARP table), then service probing on live devices only, finally name resolution. A /24 range typically finishes in 5–10 seconds; Stop interrupts it at any moment.
Web etiketi tarayıcıda arayüzü açar, RDP: The Web tag opens the interface in the browser, RDP starts remote desktop, SMB shows the shared folder in Explorer. The SSH, FTP, VNC, RTSP and database tags copy the connection address.
Önceki taramaya göre ağa yeni katılan ve: Compared with the previous scan, devices that have newly joined the network and those that no longer respond are highlighted. Matching is by MAC address, or by IP when there is no MAC; All / New / Vanished / With services filters are ready.
MAC üreticisi, uygulamaya gömülü IEEE OU: The MAC vendor is looked up offline in the IEEE OUI table embedded in the app (about 40,000 entries). For the name, reverse DNS and a single mDNS query sent to the device are used.
Çift tık ya da sağ tık ile ayrıntı pence: Double-click or right-click for the details window: the server's banner line, web page title, Server header and the TLS certificate's subject name, organisation, issuer and expiry date. Every field can be copied.
Yalnız yerel ve özel ağ adresleri taranı: Only local and private network addresses are scanned, the port list is fixed at 15 entries, the only thing done is a standard TCP connection attempt and the rate limits are built into the software. There is no vulnerability, password, SNMP or SYN scanning; the "only scan networks you are authorised for" warning stays on screen permanently.
Sonuç listesi tek tuşla CSV (UTF-8 BOM,: The result list is saved with one key as CSV (UTF-8 BOM, opens directly in Excel) or JSON. Use the inventory in a spreadsheet program or in your own scripts.

İşletim sisteminin kendi <code>ping</cod: The operating system's own ping tool is run as a child process (ping -n 1 -w <ms>); no raw socket is opened, no administrator permission is needed. Then the ARP table (arp -a) is read: devices that do not answer ping but appear in the table also count as live, and MAC addresses are taken from here.
Yalnız canlı cihazlara, sabit 15 portluk: A standard TCP connection attempt (connected / not connected) to live devices only, on the fixed 15-port list. Once the connection opens, at most: the banner line is read (SSH, FTP, VNC), a single GET / is sent (HTTP, IPP) or a TLS handshake is performed and the certificate is read (HTTPS). Not a single byte is written to the other ports.
Ters DNS (<code>dns.reverse</code>) ve c: Reverse DNS (dns.reverse) and a single mDNS PTR query sent to the device itself (5353/udp, unicast reply). Vendor from the embedded OUI table; randomised ("private") Wi-Fi addresses are shown as "private address".
Yalnız RFC 1918 (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.16: Only RFC 1918 (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) and link-local 169.254/16. An entry containing any other address is not saved. Widest range /16.
